subject: Private deployment economics — recap & next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Morales <lisa.morales@zephyr.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 15:07:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment economics — recap & next steps

Hi Lisa — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the specific items we promised to follow up on: 

1) Volume profile & unit-econ target
- You said monthly token volume today is variable but expect a steady-state in the 50M–120M tokens/month range once internal rollout completes.
- You mentioned a target commercial goal of roughly $/1M tokens between $900–$1,200 (budget-minded).

2) Deployment & security requirements
- Private/VPC deployment is required (no hosted multitenant).
- SOC 2 type II evidence required; primary data residency in US.

3) Environments & support
- Preliminary environment count: 3 (prod, staging, dev).
- Preference for enterprise support (24x7) and faster SLAs for incident response.

4) Commercial preferences
- You asked whether we price as a committed token bundle + overage, or via a per-environment perpetual license + usage. We said we would sketch both options.

Immediate next steps (to follow up by end of week):
- I’ll attach a short "playbook" that maps deployment options to rough $/1M token, one-time private deployment fees, and support tiers (attached).
- Please confirm: (a) expected steady-state monthly tokens (best single estimate), (b) preferred contract term (12 vs 24 months), and (c) whether Zephyr procurement needs an initial SOW template.

Attachments: redwood-private-pricing-playbook.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet summary), SOW_template.docx (docx stub).

Thanks — I’ll block time for a follow-up to review the numbers if that’s useful.

Best,
Karthik

From: Lisa Morales <lisa.morales@zephyr.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Walker <tom.walker@zephyr.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment economics — recap & next steps

Karthik — thanks for the summary and the playbook, useful framing. Answers inline below: 

A) Steady-state tokens: our best estimate today is 60M–80M tokens/month within the first 6 months of rollout. Peak tests may push to ~120M but not sustained.

B) $/1M target: we’re looking to land somewhere between $900–$1,100 as a target for committed volume pricing. If the model quality and latency SLAs are strong, we can flex upward.

C) Contract term & budget: procurement is targeting a 12–18 month initial term. High-level budget band our CFO has signaled is $150k–$300k ARR for this procurement.

D) Environments & support: yes — 3 environments (prod, stage, dev) plus we will need SOC 2 evidence. We require a named contact for security questionnaires and would appreciate a quick security pack.

E) Preference on commercial model: we prefer a committed monthly token bundle with a fixed monthly fee and a transparent overage rate — simpler for forecasting. If you can show a parallel option (per-environment license + smaller usage bill) we’ll evaluate.

F) Timeline: procurement expects a vendor decision and PO no later than mid-March; they want an initial SOW and draft commercial terms by end of February.

I’m copying Tom (IT ops) for environment sizing. He’ll reach out if he needs infra specifics.

Thanks — Lisa
VP Product | Zephyr AI
lisa.morales@zephyr.ai | +1 617-555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Internal — pricing approach for Zephyr (quick)

Karthik / Marissa — quick internal note based on Lisa’s reply:

- Use committed-bundle primary structure (since they prefer predictability). Recommend proposing three committed tiers: 30M, 60M, 100M tokens/mo, with blended $/1M targets: 30M @ $1,200, 60M @ $1,050, 100M @ $950.
- One-time private deployment license fee: suggest $60k–$80k depending on custom networking and HSM/KMS integration.
- Support: premium 24x7 option add-on at $30k–$40k/yr; include standard business-hours bundle in base.
- Env count: include up to 3 environments in base license; additional envs billed at $10k/env (annual).

Ask: do we want to run this as a "pilot-first" 3-month committed trial (smaller band with pro-rated license) or push straight to a 12-month committed price? My read: procurement timeframe favors a 12-month with option to scale after 90 days.

If agreed, I’ll draft the initial pricing sheet and a short SOW stub for legal to review.

Ben

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clarity, this is very helpful. Proposed path forward and preliminary commercial sketch below. If that looks directionally correct I’ll have Ben and legal prepare a short SOW and a draft commercial term sheet for your procurement team.

Preliminary commercial sketch (directional, non-binding):
- Committed monthly tokens: 60M tokens/month (baseline)
- Unit price: $1,050 / 1M tokens (applies to committed band) — results in ~$63k/month usage commitment (excl. taxes).
- Overage: committed band overage billed at $1,350 / 1M tokens.
- One-time private deployment license: $80,000 (includes basic VPC packaging, deployment runbook, and KMS integration).
- Support: Premium 24x7 add-on at $35,000 / year (includes 1-hr P1 response SLA, weekly on-call sync during onboarding). 
- Environments: 3 environments included (prod, stage, dev). Additional envs at $10,000/env/year.
- Term: 12 months minimum; option to convert to 24 months for a 5% discount on unit price.

Next steps / calendar:
1) I’ll upload a one-pager and the initial pricing worksheet to the shared drive (link below).
2) Ben will draft a short SOW and term sheet for your procurement by Tue, Feb 1.
